# JUDO JSL Fullstack Karaf Project Template

> A Maven-based project template generator that produces complete fullstack applications for the JUDO platform, using Handlebars templates to generate modular project structures targeting Apache Karaf as the OSGi runtime.

Key facts:
- Java 21, Maven 3.9.4+ with Maven Wrapper
- 4 modules: common (helpers), root (root templates), application (module templates), test
- Handlebars template engine (.hbs files) driven by YAML manifests
- 16+ boolean flags control conditional module generation (model, SDK, REST, frontend, Docker, Karaf, etc.)
- All modules packaged as OSGi bundles for Apache Karaf deployment
- Not a standalone application — consumed as a Maven dependency by `judo-jsl-generator-maven-plugin`
- License: EPL-2.0 or GPL-2.0 WITH Classpath-exception-2.0

## Modules — Template Infrastructure

- [judo-jsl-fullstack-karaf-project-template-common/pom.xml](judo-jsl-fullstack-karaf-project-template-common/pom.xml): Java helper classes for Handlebars rendering — JslProjectHelper (string transformations) and StoredVariableHelper (generation flags)
- [judo-jsl-fullstack-karaf-project-template-root/pom.xml](judo-jsl-fullstack-karaf-project-template-root/pom.xml): Handlebars templates for the root-level generated project (parent POM with fragment includes, build scripts, configs)
- [judo-jsl-fullstack-karaf-project-template-application/pom.xml](judo-jsl-fullstack-karaf-project-template-application/pom.xml): Templates for all application sub-modules (app, model, rest, sdk, frontend-react, docker, e2e, interceptors, karaf-features, keycloak-theme, schema, web-root)
- [judo-jsl-fullstack-karaf-project-template-test/pom.xml](judo-jsl-fullstack-karaf-project-template-test/pom.xml): Integration tests that invoke the generator plugin with various parameter combinations

## Modules — Template Manifests

- [judo-jsl-fullstack-karaf-project-template-common/src/main/resources/fullstack-project.yaml](judo-jsl-fullstack-karaf-project-template-common/src/main/resources/fullstack-project.yaml): Common module template manifest
- [judo-jsl-fullstack-karaf-project-template-root/src/main/resources/fullstack-project.yaml](judo-jsl-fullstack-karaf-project-template-root/src/main/resources/fullstack-project.yaml): Root module template manifest listing all root-level .hbs files
- [judo-jsl-fullstack-karaf-project-template-application/src/main/resources/fullstack-project.yaml](judo-jsl-fullstack-karaf-project-template-application/src/main/resources/fullstack-project.yaml): Application module template manifest listing all application .hbs files
